tutorial.title: How to get your reputation data
tutorial.subtitle: Two methods to export your data from Sea of Thieves
tutorial.privacyDescription: These methods only use your own data from the official website. No password or cookie is shared.

step1.title: Install the bookmarklet
step1.description: Drag this button to your bookmarks bar:

instructions.2: Right-click on your bookmarks bar → "Add page" or "Add bookmark"
instructions.4: Paste the code in the URL/Address field

step2.title: Go to Sea of Thieves
step2.description: Go to the reputation page on the official website and sign in with your Xbox account.

step3.title: Click the bookmarklet
step3.description: Once logged in on seaofthieves.com, click the bookmarklet in your bookmarks bar. A window will appear with two options:
step3.optionImportDescription: Sends your data directly to our site. You will be redirected to finalize the import.
step3.optionCopyDescription: Copies the JSON to your clipboard for manual import later.

manual.intro: This method is more technical but works on all browsers.
manual.mobile1: On mobile, importing requires running the bookmarklet: Sea of Thieves blocks any other access to its data. Not all mobile browsers support bookmarklets.
manual.mobile2: Android — Firefox or Kiwi: copy the bookmarklet code above, create a bookmark (on any page) and paste the code into its address, then open seaofthieves.com (logged in) and run the bookmark.
manual.mobile3: iOS — Safari: add the bookmarklet as a favorite, edit the favorite's address to paste the code, then run it from seaofthieves.com.
manual.mobile4: Chrome (Android) doesn't support bookmarklets. The easiest option is to import from a computer.
manual.step1Description: Go to the reputation page and sign in.
manual.step2Description: Language selector at the bottom of the page.
manual.step6Description: Type "reputation" in the search bar to find the /api/profilev2/reputation request
manual.step7Description: Click on the request, go to the "Response" tab and copy all the content (Ctrl+A then Ctrl+C).
manual.step8Description: Go back to the "My Reputations" page and paste the JSON in the import field.

fishing.title: Fishing guide
fishing.description: Fish, bait, cooking and Hunter's Call commendations.

basics.equip: Take out the fishing rod from the 2nd page of the item wheel (a shortcut can be bound in the options).
basics.cast: Cast the bobber into the sea or a lagoon: after a few seconds a fish bites and starts fighting.
basics.tension: Pull the mouse or stick in the opposite direction to the fish to avoid snapping the line.
basics.reel: Once it tires, reel in (left click / right trigger). Trophy fish often take several rounds.
basics.cancel: Before a bite, right click (or B on controller) reels the line back if you don't want that fish.
basics.tired: The line goes slack and the fish stops moving, the struggling sounds stop and the controller stops vibrating.

bait.intro: Bait never guarantees a species, it only increases its chances to show up.
bait.whereEarthworms: Dig in the dirt of grassy areas.
bait.whereLeeches: Dig where the water meets the sand.
bait.barrels: All bait can also be found in barrels and crates.
bait.storage: 10 bait per slot, plus 1 attached to the rod (11 in total).
bait.buyShipwright: Captained ship: the shipwright sells 10 of each bait for 3,500 gold.
bait.buyCrate: Hunter's Call and Merchant Alliance: crate of 50 of each bait for 5,000 gold.
bait.raw: Eating raw bait makes you sick and barely restores any health.

species.intro: Each species has 5 varieties (3 common, 1 night, 1 rare), each in normal or trophy size. Trophies give more gold and reputation.
species.search: Search a fish or an island…

splashtail.name: Splashtail
splashtail.location: Everywhere except fresh water and the Sea of the Damned

islehopper.name: Islehopper
islehopper.location: Around large islands (variety depends on the island)

battlegill.name: Battlegill
battlegill.location: Near active skeleton forts and skeleton ships

cooking.heal: Cooked fish grants a health reserve that regenerates your health after 8 to 10 s without taking damage. Avoid raw fish.
cooking.found: Fish (raw, cooked or burnt) can also be found in shipwrecks, floating barrels, rowboats and crates: the state only affects the sell price.

commendations.perVariant: One "… Hunter" commendation per variety, plus one per complete species.
commendations.trophy25: Hunter of Trophy Fish: 25 trophies delivered
commendations.trophy50: Master Hunter of Trophy Fish: 50 trophies
commendations.trophy100: Legendary Hunter of Trophy Fish: 100 trophies
commendations.legendary: Legendary Hunter of the Sea of Thieves: every Hunter's Call commendation at grade V.
commendations.athena: Athena's Fortune – Legend of the Deep: deliver 50 fish as a Pirate Legend.
commendations.sell: To the Hunter's Call, the Merchant Alliance, or the Barons aboard a captained ship.

junk.intro: Fishing without bait sometimes brings up items: old hat, old boot, old skull, fish bones… even planks or Ashen Keys.
junk.value: Not worth much, but required for the "Hunter of Sneaky Loot" commendation.
junk.spots: Good spots: Cursewater Shore (Y13) and Mermaid's Hideaway (B13).

tips.trophy: No bait or trick forces a trophy to appear, and recasting with a fish hooked changes nothing.
tips.skeletons: To fish in peace, stay near an outpost, a seapost or an inactive skeleton fort, or swim away from shore (watch out for sharks).
tips.shadowStorm: Shadow Stormfish: wait for the storm to pass near the Glorious Sea Dog Tavern (K12).
tips.storm: To find the storm, use the Merfolk's Lullaby live tracker.
tips.volcano: In the Devil's Roar, eruptions can snap the line and damage the ship.

merrick.intro: Create the list of the menu Merrick asks for, then share the link with your crew: everyone ticks off what they catch or hunt, and the list updates live for everyone.
merrick.ocrHint: Upload a screenshot of the menu: the list is filled in automatically. Check it before creating it.

merrick.invalid: Each dish must contain at least one ingredient.
merrick.shareHint: Anyone with this link can view and tick off the list.
merrick.notFound: This list does not exist or has expired.
merrick.expiry: Lists inactive for 14 days are deleted automatically.
